comparison.objective: Square and close a sanitary tri-clamp over two ferrules; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual clamp alignment and wing-nut draw-up versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, fine collar adjustment, and bounded relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp seated square on both ferrules before tightening versus two safe dynamic stops with travel and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Shared tightening and alignment are generic; sanitary joint assembly does not test response-based calibration. Record specs and torque/leak/damage thresholds are missing.
